name: mini-messageboard
description: Tablon de mensajes full-stack: API Express + SPA React

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
